Change c0530. Location: 1818 Vol. III, Ch. VII; 1831 Ch. XXIV.

Context before (unchanged): Urged by this view, I refused, and I did right in refusing, to create a companion for the first creature.

1818 text: He shewed unparalleled malignity and selfishness, in evil: he destroyed my friends; he devoted to destruction beings who possessed exquisite sensations, happiness, and wisdom; nor do I know where this thirst for vengeance may end.

1831 text: He showed unparalleled malignity and selfishness, in evil: he destroyed my friends; he devoted to destruction beings who possessed exquisite sensations, happiness, and wisdom; nor do I know where this thirst for vengeance may end.

Diff: He [-shewed-] {+showed+} unparalleled malignity and selfishness, in evil: he destroyed my friends; he devoted to destruction beings who possessed exquisite sensations, happiness, and wisdom; nor do I know where this thirst for vengeance may end.

Context after (unchanged): Miserable himself, that he may render no other wretched, he ought to die.

result.rationale: Only change is orthographic: 'shewed' becomes 'showed' with identical wording and meaning. No interpretive consequence for the passage.
